description: IPFS content persistence for OpenClaw via a local kubo node. Adds files to IPFS, pins them so they stay robust while active, and tracks a per-file TTL in a ledger. `decay` unpins entries not referenced within their TTL and garbage-collects the repo; a systemd user timer runs it daily so unused content decays naturally without manual cleanup. Reports only CIDs and status the ipfs CLI actually returned.
